### `xpath` matcher

XPath expression match (ChrisTrenkamp/xsel engine). doMatch chains the XPath result. Non-string value never matches. https://docs.hoverfly.io/en/latest/pages/keyconcepts/matching/matchers.html

**Value type:** `string`
**Config:** not supported.
**doMatch:** transforms/extracts a value for the next chained matcher (not a re-test of the same input).
